Don Silver' daughter is naïve[XENO:n ]
and clueless.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]She is often taken advantage of[XENO:n ]
and easily taken for a fool.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]There are many different people[XENO:n ]
gathered in this colony.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I wish that she would not forget to[XENO:n ]
conduct herself with dignity.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]And above all remember that she[XENO:n ]
is a proud High Entia.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

No matter the situation, we High[XENO:n ]
Entia must remember who we are.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Our innate sense of resolve and[XENO:n ]
dignity will see us through.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]We must teach our daughters and[XENO:n ]
sons the proper way to act.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]And we do this for the next[XENO:n ]
generation for their own benefit.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I saw Don Silver' daughter[XENO:n ]
together and alone with a Homs.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]They were being more than[XENO:n ]
friendly, if you ask me.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I do not envy a High Entia father[XENO:n ]
in such a position as his![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I do not know if I have got this[XENO:n ]
wrong or right...[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But a High Entia girl and a Homs[XENO:n ]
boy together...[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I have a boy myself, but I don't[XENO:n ]
wish to experience that at all...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Don Silver seems to have[XENO:n ]
changed his mind.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]He's even taken up house with[XENO:n ]
his daughter AND the boy.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I suppose new places bring new[XENO:n ]
ways of living...[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I don't think it's a bad thing.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

My boy has fallen in love with a[XENO:n ]
Homs girl. It had to happen...[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I shared my concerns with him[XENO:n ]
and he ran off to elope![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I hope he returns to me soon.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Apparently, there are doors on[XENO:n ]
Giant God only High Entia can open.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Or more accurately, someone who[XENO:n ]
possesses a High Entia item.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I don't know who I heard that from,[XENO:n ]
but I am sure it is correct.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I did hear it while in Achamoth,[XENO:n ]
I am sure of that at least.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]The only problem is the item itself.[XENO:n ]
It's not easy to find.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I think I heard something about it,[XENO:n ]
but...[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]No. It's gone.[XENO:n ]
Sorry![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I remembered what I heard about[XENO:n ]
the doors that can't be opened.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Now this is all hearsay, but[XENO:n ]
Seagal is the one who told me.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]He escaped to Satorl Marsh.[XENO:n ]
Why not give him a visit?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Wouldn't it be fun to know what's[XENO:n ]
on the other side of those doors?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Do you think there is some sort[XENO:n ]
of treasure waiting to be found?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Maybe it is a...monster![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

This one wants to join the Defence[XENO:n ]
Force.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Jobs where you get to protect[XENO:n ]
people are the most important![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]A job on the force will give him[XENO:n ]
a clear sense of responsibility.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But more than that, I hope he[XENO:n ]
becomes a kind-hearted boy.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]The rest is up to him![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

You lot look like a good[XENO:n ]
bunch of people.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Keep up the good work for my boy[XENO:n ]
and all the young ones round here.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]They look up to you.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]And who knows? Maybe one day[XENO:n ]
my boy'll be as brave as you lot.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I heard Colony 9's got itself[XENO:n ]
a female lieutenant colonel.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]And a fine one at that as well![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Good that someone so right for the[XENO:n ]
job came from that feeble squad.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Now if only my boy would grow up[XENO:n ]
to be as tough as she is...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

If my boy gets as big as me,[XENO:n ]
he'll be perfect for the force.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]What's that?[XENO:n ]
I'm too big?![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]You wanna go a round?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Oh, wait a second.[XENO:n ]
Better not. The boy's watching.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I'm gonna join the Defence Force![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Stand back before I give you[XENO:n ]
a knuckle sandwich to the face![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Aaaah![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

How does the Defence Force[XENO:n ]
defend stuff?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Do you think my knuckle sandwich[XENO:n ]
is enough to defend people?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Where can I learn better versions[XENO:n ]
of my knuckle sandwich?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I know that I can't just be all[XENO:n ]
muscle like my dad.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]The Defence Force needs people[XENO:n ]
with different skills as well.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Like...a good heart.[XENO:n ]
That's what Dad says anyway...[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I'm gonna be a great soldier.[XENO:n ]
You just wait and see.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I wanna see what this colony looks[XENO:n ]
like in ten years from now.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I bet it'll be big and massive with[XENO:n ]
loads of people living in it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Then the Defence Force will be[XENO:n ]
full of tough guys like me.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I hope I make it in![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
